items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: I think Mr. Robinson was secretary. I was too young at the game to pay any attention to that side of it.

ctx.x: I, I wasn't necessarily a part of the union --
He was -- I think he was secretary. He worked -- not worked, but he acted as secretary. I think Mr. Robinson was secretary. I was too young at the game to pay any attention to that side of it.
How did you happen to join the union?
